title: Styles, Lynn & Low Ki define the X Division
summary: AJ Styles, Jerry Lynn and Low Ki turn the new X Division into a competitive showcase. Respect between the veteran Lynn and the rising Styles gives way to rivalry as the title changes hands.

chapters.title: Styles becomes the first X champion
chapters.result: Styles wins a four-way double-elimination match over Lynn, Low Ki and Psicosis.
chapters.context: The broadcast introduces the division’s first champion and the contrasting styles of its foundational rivals. This is the air date, rather than the earlier recording date.

chapters.title: Low Ki breaks through
chapters.result: Low Ki defeats Styles and Lynn to win the X Division title.
chapters.context: The three-way competition prevents the division from becoming a simple mentor-and-protégé story: Low Ki is an equal threat to both men.

chapters.title: Lynn wins the ladder showdown
chapters.result: Jerry Lynn defeats Low Ki and Styles in a three-way ladder match for the title.
chapters.context: Their rivalry escalates into a ladder match, completing a title exchange among all three pioneers. The date follows the broadcast.
